positions.name: RehearsalConstitutesCapability
positions.frame: does a capability count as genuinely held only once it has been rehearsed, and what cadence secures that?
positions.why: The directive fixes a monthly rehearsal cadence for Atlas rollbacks (src-1), and the aphoristic assertion supplies the warrant for why cadence matters at all — an unrehearsed rollback is treated as no rollback (src-2). Read together, both expressions perform the same underlying stance (value: competence/conservation; conviction: decision and principle both load-bearing, unhedged) that rehearsal is constitutive of, not incidental to, having the capability. The tension between the two acts — a flat operational order versus a crystallized maxim — is held within the frame rather than resolved: one performs the policy, the other performs its justification.
